column1: Job Hazard Analysis is a process where hazards associated with each step of a task/activity are identified and control measures are put in place to minimise the risk to people, environment and property
Determine if a JHA is required.
Break the job into logical steps.
Develop hazard control solutions which reduce the identified  risks
Record the JHA on the standard form and assess the risk with the control measures in place.  Proceed to do the job ONLY after obtaining necessary approvals and sign-off
Integrate risk control measures into work training program.
Review and update the JHA after completing the job
